title: oenothera curtiflora
intro: Oenothera curtiflora, commonly known as the evening primrose, is a flowering plant native to North America. The evening primrose is valued for its oil, which is rich in gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), a polyunsaturated fatty acid. The health benefits of evening primrose oil include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of menopause, eczema, and other skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of evening primrose oil include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, attributed to bioactive constituents such as GLA, linoleic acid, and other polyunsaturated fatty acids.
